tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnam grangs kyi mdo slob phan zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga gang zhe na/ chos dang dus dang ston pa dang gnas dang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /chos dus ston pa gnas dang 'khor/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga ru 'dod/ /kun shes rta thul rlangs pa dang*/ /ming can bzang ldan lnga sde'o/ /grags pa dri med gang po dang*/ /ba lang bdag dang lag bzang ni/ /nye ba'i lnga sde zhes su brjod/ /dga' bo nyer dga' 'gro mgyogs dang*/ /'char ka 'dun pa nam so ste/ /drug sde zhes su brjod pa yin/ /'od srung kun dga' sha na'i gos/ /nyer sbas dhi dhi ka nag po/ /legs mthong bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ /stag mo shi bi ko sa la/ /tshong dpon gnyis dang ri bong dang*/ ā gasta dang sha byin dang*/ /thams cad sgrol dang mchod sbyin byed/ /brgya byin bram ze myos byed ma/ /legs par pha rol phyin dang nya/ /bya dang bum pa phyug po'i bu/ /dka' thub can dang tshong dpon no/ /byang chub dang ba byang chub che/ spre'u ri dwags sha ra bha/ /ru ru sprel rgyal bzod par smra/ /tshangs pa gling chen dag ste bcu/ /zla ba lcags kyi khyim na skyes/ /ma he shing rta mo zhes pa/ /skyes rabs sum cu rtsa bzhi yin/ gzhan ni brjod las 'das pa'o/ /mnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka /wā rā ṇa siyangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab ste grong khyer drug /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang*/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltam pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi mkhor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis zhes su grags/ /mdo sde dbyangs snyan lung du bstan/ /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*/ /rtogs brjod de lta bu 'byung dang*/ /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ /rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/

/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dang*/ /rtsod ldan zhes bya dus bzhi yin/ /dpyid sos dbyar ston dgun gnyis ni/ /dus drug dgun dpyid dbyar dus gsum/ /dus bzang dus ngan bsam mi khyab/ /gsang ba'i dus ni gsum du brjod/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga las 'phros pa'i rabs te dang po'o// //mig rna sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos ni/ /skye mched bcu gnyis zhes su brjod/ /bcu gnyis po de'i steng du ni/ /mig rna sna lce lus yid kyi/ /rnam shes bsnan pas khams bco brgyad/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed dang*/ /rnam shes rnams te phung po lnga/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga/ /mig rna sna lce lus dbang lnga/ /rig byed min pa'i gzugs zhes pa/ /bcu gcig po de gzugs phung yin/ /mig sogs 'dus te reg pa drug /reg pa'i tshor ba drug yin te/ yang na bde sdug btang snyoms dang*/ /yid bde yid mi bde ba lnga/ /reg drug las byung 'du shes drug /mtshan bcas mtshan med chung che dang*/ /tshad med ci yang med 'du shes/ /'du byed mtshungs ldan mi ldan gnyis/ /rnam shes drug po sngar bshad zin/ /sngo ser dkar dmar ring thung dang*/ /lham pa zlum po mtho dma' dang*/ /phya le phya le ma yin dang*/ /sprin dang du ba rdul khug rna/ /grib ma nyi ma snang mun no/ /zin dang ma zin de gnyis la/ /ston dang mi ston gnyis gnyis bzhi/ /de yang snyan dang mi snyan brgyad/ /dri zhim mi zhim mnyam mi mnyam/ /yang na lhan skyes sbyar byung bzhi/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa kha tsha bska/ /ro drug 'byung bzhi 'jam rtsub dang*/ /lci yang grang bkres skom reg bya/ /bcu gcig tu ni brjod pa yin/ /nyer dgu bcu gcig drug bcu gnyis/ /nyer drug theg chen gzhung las bshad/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang*/ 'du shes med dang 'gog snyoms dang*/ /'du shes med pa'i sems can dang*/

/srog dang skye rga gnas dang 'jig /ming tshig ye ge bcu bzhi po/ /ldan min 'du byed ces pa'o/ /nyer gsum rnal 'byor spyod gzhung las/ /nam mkha' so sor brtags 'gog dang*/ /brtags min 'gog gsum 'dus ma byas/ / gzhan las 'dus ma byas brgyad bshad/ /rnam shes drug dang nyon yid dang*/ / kun gzhi rnam shes zhes bya ba/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad ces su brjod/ /kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga/ /rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon mongs/ /nyi shu dad sogs dge bcu gcig /gzhan 'gyur bzhi ste sems byung yin/ /tshor 'du sems pa reg yid byed/ /'dun mos dran ting shes rab lnga/ /'dod khong nga ma the tshom lta/ khro dang 'khon 'dzin ser sna 'chab/ /g.yo sgyu rgyags dang rnam 'tshe dang*/ /'tshig dang phrag dog med gnyis dang*/ /ma dad pa dang rmugs dang rgod/ /le lo bag med brjed nges dang*/ /shes bzhin min dang rnam g.yeng ngo*/ /dad dang bag yod shin tu sbyangs/ /btang snyoms ngo tsha shes khrel yod/ /rtsa ba rnam gsum mi 'tshe dang*/ /brtson 'grus dge ba bcu gcig go /gnyid 'gyod rtog dpyod gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ /reg drug las byung sems pa drug /dge phyir kun nyon mongs phyir dang*/ /gnas skabs bye brag la sems pa/ /gsum du dbye bas bco brgyad yin/ /srid dang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags gnyis/ /nga rgyal che ba'i nga rgyal dang*/ /nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal dang*/ /nga'o snyam dang mngon nga rgyal/ /cung zad snyam dang log nga rgyal/ /lta ngan gnyis te rtag chad gnyis/ /log lta 'jig tshogs mthar 'dzin dang*/ /tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin lta mchog 'dzin/ /lta ngan lnga zhes brjod pa yin/ /gzugs bdag ma yin bdag ldan min/ /bdag la gzugs med gzugs la med/ /phung po bzhi la'ang de bzhin sbyar/ /'jig tshogs lta ba nyi shur 'dod/ /bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' ldan dang*/ /mi ldan gnyis ka gnyis min dang*/ /rtag mi rtag gnyis gnyis ka min/

/de bzhin gshegs pa grongs phan chad/ /'byung min 'byung gnyis gnyis ka min/ /bdag srog gcig gam tha dad ces/ /lung ma bstan lta bcu bzhi yin/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye mched drug reg pa/ /tshor ba sred len srid pa dang*/ /skye ba rga shi rten 'brel ni/ /bcu gnyis zhes su brjod pa yin/ / dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/ /mi rnams dang ni 'dod lha drug /yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms dang*/ ngu 'bod ngu 'bod chen po dang*/ /tsha ba rab tsha mnar med pa/ /chu bur chu bur brdol ba dang*/ /a chu kye hud so tham pa/ / ut+pal pad+ma pad cher gas/ me ma mur dang ro myag dang*/ /spu gri sogs gsum chu bo yin/ /rgyal chen bzhi rigs sum cu gsum/ /'thab bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang*/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ces lha drug /gnyis ka 'khyud dang lag bcang dang*/ rgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa'o/ /dud 'gro yi dwags bying kha 'thor/ /phyi nang zas sgrib yi dwags gsum/ /brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /yi dwags so drug dud 'gro ni/ /bye ba mang por mdo las gsungs/ /'di nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu 'das gangs ri'o de nas ni/ /spos ngad ldan pa'i tshur rol na/ /chu zheng lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho/ /gaṅgā glang po kha nas shar/ /sin+dhu glang gi kha nas lho/ /pak+ṣu rta yi kha nas nub/ /si tā seṅge'i kha nas byang*/ /ma dros rdzing bu dal 'bab dang*/ /gser gyi bya skyibs sā la'i rgyal/ /glang chen sa srung bu rab brtan/ khang bu can dang sprin gyi shugs/ /lhun po gnya' shing 'dzin ri dang*/ /gshol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldan can/ /de bzhin lta na sdug ri dang*/ /lta na dang ni rnam 'dud dang/ /mu 'khyud 'dzin dang lcags ri'o/ /rol mtsho bdun dang ba tshwa'i mtsho/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi sogs la/ /lag na gzhong thogs phreng thogs dang/ /rtag myos pi waṃ can gsum pa/ /bar snang sa bla'i gnod sbyin dang*/

/kun tu rgyu ba'i lha rnams so/ /yul 'khor dang ni 'phags par skyes/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang lcang lo can/ /rgyal po 'jig rten skyong bzhi gnas/ /gnya' shing 'dzin ri'i rtse mo la'o/ /lhun po'i rtse na sum cu gsum/ / lta na sdug rnams khang bzang dang*/ /chos bzang yongs 'du'i tshal dang ni/ /phyi rol shing rta sna tshogs dang/ /rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dga' bas brgyan/ /de dag gi ni phyogs bzhi na/ /nyi shus bcad na sa gzhi bzang*/ /byang shar mtshams na yongs 'du ste/ /lho nub mtshams na chos bzang ngo*/ /de steng lha rnams gzhal med khang*/ /'dod pa spyod pa drug yin no/ /zla phreng bzang po gser ldan dang/ /mi g.yo ba ste sa bzhi bzhi/ /'od can skar phreng zab pa dang*/ /mdzes pa zhes te grong khyer bzhi/ /sgra gcan mgul phreng me tog dang*/ /thag bzang ris te dbang po bzhi/ /lho nub mtshams na nor bzang dang*/ /byang shar mtshams na tsi tas li/ khang bzang gtams pa can dang ni/ /tshal bzhi bzod dka' gangs brtsegs dang*/ /skrag 'jigs sogs kyis lha min bsdus/ /tshangs ris tshangs pa 'dun na 'don/ /tshangs chen bsam gtan dang po yin/ /'od chung tshad med 'od 'od gsal/ /gnyis pa'o dge chung tshad med dge /dge rgyas bsam gtan gsum pa yin/ /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang ni/ /'bras bu che zhes gnas gsum dang*/ /mi che mi gdung gya nom snang*/ /shin tu mthong dang 'og min ni/ /gnas gtsang lnga ste bzhi pa yin/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang*/ /rnam shes mtha' yas ci yang med/ /srid rtse zhes bya gzugs med bzhi/ khams gsum 'dod khams gzugs khams dang*/ /gzugs med khams rnams rim pa bzhin/ /nyi shu bcu bdun bzhi yin no/ /til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhig /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus sgyur/ /yang gsos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/

/rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyis bskal pa'o dud 'gro rnams/ /mchog ring bskal pa'o yi dwags rnams/ /zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ /gling bzhi ba dang nyi zla dang*/ /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /'dzam bu'i gling ba rnams kyi tshad/ /khru bzhi pa dang phyed dang bzhi/ /shar dang ba lang spyod dang ni/ /byang zhes bya ba nyis 'gyur bskyed/ /'dod dang ldan pa'i lha'i lus/ /bzhi cha nas ni rgyang grags dag /byed dang gnyis kyi bar du bskyed/ /gzugs can dang po dpag tshad phyed/ /de yis gong ma phyed phyed bskyed/ /'od chung rnams kyi lhag yan chad/ /lus ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te/ /sprin med dpag tshad gsum dor ro/ /sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste/ /nub shar lnga brgya phyed sum brgya/ /'di ni ma nges tha mar ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ /mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las/ /'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro/ /gzugs can nyin mtshan med tshe ni/ /rang lus gzhal ba'i bskal pa yin/ /gzugs med bskal pa stong phrag ni/ nyi shu lhag pas lhag pa yin/ /'od chung nas gzung bskal chen te/ /de yi 'og ma phyed yin no/ /gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang*/ /skad cig phra rags rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dag ni de bzhin du/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang*/ /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma shig /sor tshig zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*/ /de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni/ / rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/

/de'i skad cig de dag kyang*/ /drug cu la ni thang gcig go / yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /'chags dang 'jig dang gnas dang zhig /bar bskal bskal chen bskal chung dang*/ / mtshon dang nad dang mu ge sogs/ /bskal pa rnam pa mang po yin/ /las la sems pa bsam pa gnyis/ /myong bar nges dang ma nges gnyis/ /rnam rig rnam rig byed min gnyis/ /'phen byed rdzogs byed las gnyis so/ /kun slong rnam gnyis rgyu dang ni/ /de'i dus kyi slong zhes bya/ /rig byed min rnam sum zhes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ /sdom pa so sor thar zhes bya/ /de bzhin bsam gtan zag med skyes/ /bsod nams bsod nams min mi g.yo/ /las ni rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /sdug bsngal myong 'gyur bde myong 'gyur/ /sdug min bde min myong 'gyur gsum/ /mthong chos dang ni skyes nas dang*/ /lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gsum/ /las dkar rnam smin gnag pa dang*/ / las gnag rnam smin dkar ba dang*/ /gnyis kar dkar dang gnyis ka nag /dkar dang nag dang 'dres ma dang*/ /mi dkar mi nag de yang gsum/ /dkar nag gnyis ka zad byed pa'o/ /mtshams med skyes nas myong 'gyur yin/ /bde gshegs sku la ngan sems kyis/ /sku mtshal 'byin dang dgra bcom gsod/ /pha ma gsod dang dge 'dun dbyen/ /ma dgra bcom ma sun byas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges gnas dang*/ /slob pa gsod dang dge 'dun gyi/ /'du ba'i sgo nas 'phrog pa dag /mtshams med pa dang cha 'dra ste/ /lnga pa mchod rten bajig pa yin/ /srog gcod log g.yem ma byin len/ / phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal rdzun/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta ni/ /byed na mi dge spangs dge bcu/ /tshe thung dgra mang 'phongs pa dang*/ /bshes bral mi snyan ngag mi btsun/ /skur ba re ba 'jom pa dag /'jig bcas lta ngan gyis rmongs pa'i/ /gzi chung lo nyes rdul 'khrig dang*/

/dri nga mtho dman tsha sgo skyes/ /dus log dgun dus sogs tha chad/ /'bru kha 'bras bu med pa'o/ /kun gyi rnam smin ngan 'gro ste/ /thams cad bdag po rgyu 'thun dang*/ /rnam smin 'bras bu yin par 'dod/ /sdug bsngal phyir dang bsad phyir dang*/ /gzi byin med phyir 'bras rnam gsum/ /mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las/ /zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par las/ /gang dag 'gog byams nyon mongs med/ /mthong dang dgra bcom 'bras langs pa/ /de la phan gnod byas pa yis/ /'bras bu 'phral du myong bar 'gyur/ /'gro dang sdug bsngal phan 'dogs dang*/ /yon tan rnams kyi zhing khyad 'phags/ /'phags pa min yang pha ma dang*/ /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang*/ /skyes mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /yon ni gzhal tu med pa yin/ /'jug dang zhing dang gzhi dang ni/ /sbyor dang sems pa bsam pa ste/ /de dag chung dang che ba las/ /las kyang chung dang che ba yin/ /bsam bzhin pa dang rdzogs pa dang*/ /mi 'gyod gnyen po med pa dang*/ /'khor dang rnam par smin pa las/ /bsags pa'i las shes bya ba yin/ /las su rnam smin sgrib pa gsum/ /sdug bsngal gsum mam brgyad ces bya/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal 'gyur sdug bsngal/ /'du byed sdug bsngal zhes pa'o/ /nyon mongs mthong bas spang bya dang*/ /sgom pas spang bya gnyis su 'du/ /gnyis ka'ang khams gsum so sos bsdus/ /byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung ba dang*/ /skal mnyam mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ /kun tu 'gro dang rnam smin te/ /rgyu ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /rkyen rnam bzhi te rgyu dang ni/ /dmigs pa dang ni de ma thag /bdag po yang ni de bzhin te/ /rkyen lnga pa ni yod ma yin/ /rnam smin bdag po rgyu 'thun dang*/ /skyes bu byed dang bral 'bras lnga/ /rgyu drug rkyen bzhi 'bras bu lnga'o// gzhi'i chos kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen pha ma dang*/ /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma/

/ dge slong pha ma so thar brgyad/ /tshogs spyor mthong sgom mi slob lam/ /lam lnga zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gsum/ /lha dang tshangs pa'i theg ste lnga/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das theg gnyis/ /lus tshor sems dang chos rnams kyi/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /dge ba ma skyes bskyed pa dang*/ /skyes pa srung dang mi dge ba/ /skyes spong ma skyes mi skyed pa'o/ /'dun brtson sems dpyod ces bya ba/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /dad brtson dran ting shes rab ni/ /dbang po lnga dang stobs lngar brjod/ /dran shes brtson dga' sbyangs ting btang*/ /byang chub yan lag bdun du brjod/ /rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ /bzhi ba phan yon yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag /lta rtog ngag las 'tsho dang rtsol/ /dran ting 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog dang lam/ /bden pa bzhi zhes rab tu bsgrag /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /rgyu dang kun 'byung rkyen rab skye/ /'gog zhi gya noms nges 'byung dang*/ /lam dang rig sgrub nges 'byin te/ /mi rtag sogs rnams bcu drug go /chos dang gang zag bdag med gnyis/ /rnam thar sgo ni stong nyid dang*/ /mtshan med smon med rnam gsum mo/ /stong nyid stong nyid la sogs gsum/ /phyi nang gnyis ka stong pa che/ /don dam 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /mtha' las 'das dang thog ma med/ /dor med rang bzhin chos thams cad/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dang mi dmigs/ /dngos med ngo bo dngos po dang*/ /dngos po med pa'i stong nyid ni/ /bco brgyad rang dang gzhan ngo bo/ /stong nyid bsnan pas nyi shu yin/ /gnyen po rnam bzhi spong ba dang*/ /gzhi dang thag sring sun 'byin pa'o/ /mdor na lam ni rnam bzhi ste/ khyad par can dang rnam grol dang*/ /bar chad med dang sbyor zhes bya/

/tshogs lam che 'bring chung gsum ste/ /sbyor lam drod rtse bzod chos mchog /re re'ang che 'bring chung gsum mo/ /sdug bsngal chos bzod chos shes dang*/ /rjes bzod rjes shes zhes pa bzhi/ /kun 'byung 'gog lam la bzhi bzhi/ /mthong lam skad cig bcu drug go /sgom lam chung ngu'i chung sogs dgu/ /nyams pa 'chi sems rjes su bsrung*/ /gnas las mi bskyod rtogs skal can/ /mi g.yo chos can zhes pa drug /dgra bcom slob dang byas la 'dod/ /mtshan nyid rab rig mos dben byung*/ /dga' sdud spyod pa sbyor ba'i mtha'/ /sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu yid byed bdun/ /mig rna gzhan sngon rdzu 'phrul zab*/ /mngon shes drug tu brjod pa yin/ /bsam gtan yan lag bco brgyad ni/ /dang po la lnga rtog dpyod dang*/ /dga' dang bde dang ting 'dzin rnams/ /gnyis pa la ni yan lag bzhi/ /rab dang dang ni dga' la sogs/ /gsum pa la lnga btang snyoms dang*/ /dran dang shes bzhin bde dang gnas/ /mtha' na bzhi dran btang snyoms dang*/ /bde min sdug min ting 'dzin no/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*/ /btang snyoms tshad med tshad med bzhi/ /bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug sogs/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /'gog snyoms zhes pa snyoms 'jug dgu /gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i dang*/ /gzugs med gzugs lta khyad par sdug /gzugs med bzhi dang 'gog pa yi/ /rnam par thar ba brgyad yin no/ /zad par sngon po'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /ser dmar dkar dang sa chu me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' rnam shes bcu/ /nang gzugs 'du shes phyi yi gzugs/ /chung ngu bzang ngan zil gnon dang*/ /chen po zil gnon nang gzugs med/ /sngar bzhin che chung zil gnon gnyis/ /sngo ser dmar dkar zil gnon bzhi/ /de ltar zil gnon brgyad du dran/ /chos shes rjes shes gzhan sems shes/ /kun rdzob sdug kun 'gog lam dang*/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa bcu/ /dbang po rtul dang rnon po dang*/

/dad dang mthong thob rigs nas rigs/ /bar chad gcig par skyes nas dang*/ /byed dang byed min 'og min 'gro/ /'phar gsum srid rtse mthar thug 'gro/ /gzugs la chags bcom mthong ba yi/ /chos la zhi lus mngon sum byed/ /bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub ni/ /mtshan nyid gsum zhes brjod par bya/ /mtshan nyid skye ba don dam ste/ /ngo bo nyid med gsum du brjod/ /dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir/ /rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /thog ma med nas brgyud 'ongs dang*/ /skye mched drug gi khyad par 'dra/ /chos nyid kyis thob sangs rgyas rigs/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*/ /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /chos la khong khro bdag lta dang*/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs dang*/ /sems can don la ltos med nyid/ / 'dod chen mu stegs nyan thos dang*/ /rang byung rnams gyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab dang*/ /ting 'dzin snying brtse lam bzhi'o/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras/ /sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun pa snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras phyung dang*/ /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*/ /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas sgrib pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas/ /sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang*/ /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spangs don du gsungs/ /chu khams gser dang nam mkha' ni/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/

/byang sems mtshan bcu drug po ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' che/ /blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni/ /rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*/ /rtsal ldan dang ni 'phags mchog dang*/ /ded dpon dang ni bsod nams che/ /dbang phyug de bzhin chos dang ldan/ /gzungs ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /bzod pa sngags chos don gyi gzungs/ /thos 'dzin don ston la mi 'jigs/ /bdag med srung ba phun tshogs dang*/ /thabs shes mthar phyin bar chad med/ /sems can don la mi 'jigs te/ /rgyal sras mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'o/ /ma bstan par yang sbyin la 'dug /tshul bzod brtson bsam shes bsdu dngos/ /yongs bsngo shes dang nges 'byung ston/ /theg las ma nyams lam gnyis ston/ /zung dang sel bzhi'i rgyud la mkhas/ /ye shes sngon 'gro 'du mi byed/ /sgo gsum dge ba bcu dang ldan/ /bzod pas sems can yongs mi gtong/ /'gro kun mngon par dga' bar ston/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems ma nyams/ /dkon mchog rtsa bar bstan pa las/ /mi ldog rgyal sras ma 'dres chos/ /bsam lhag sbyor shes smon theg spyaud/ /rnam 'phrul byang chub chos 'khor stobs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu yin/ /tshe sems las yo skye mos dang*/ /smon rdzu ye chos dbang bcu yin/ /smon 'jug kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /sems bskyed gnyis gnyis brjod pa yin/ /sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba gom pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan byung ba/ /gzhan gyis brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /rigs dang chos la mos pa dang*/ /de bzhin sems ni bskyed pa dang*/ /sbyin la sogs pa sgrub pa dang*/ /skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang*/ /sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang*/

/zhing ni rnam par sbyong pa dang*/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ /byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o/ /gcig ni mos pa dang ldan pa/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dag dang gzhan/ /mtshan ma dang ni mtshan med dang*/ /mngon par 'du byed med spyod pa/ /lnga po 'di dag sa kun la/ /byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes bya/ /brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /brtan pa nyid dang lag brkyangs dang*/ /dgongs pa zab mo nges 'grel ba/ /'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi rtags/ /ngo bo nyid dang gnas dang ni/ /'bras bu go rim bsdu ba yin/ /yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*/ /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*/ /'chad dang kha bton byed pa dang*/ /de sems pa dang sgom pa ni/ /spyod pa de bcu'i bdag nyid de/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gtong*/ /tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa drug /gos gsum phying ba phyag dar khrod/ /bsod snyoms stan gcig phyis mi len/ /dgon pa shing drung bla gab med/ /dur khrod cog pu bzhi ji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yin/ /bsod snyoms phyag dar khrod shing drung*/ /sman bkus bor ba gnas bzhi'o/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar/ /shes rab thos bsam sgom byung gsum/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sgom byung gi /bsod nams rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes dang*/ /rnag 'bus bam dmar zos 'thor zhig /rus gong 'du shes mi sdug dgu/ /bgrang dang rjes 'gro rtog pa dang*/ /'jog dang rgyur dang yongs dag ste/ /dbugs bgrang ba yi'i man ngag go mi sdug byams dang rten 'brel rlung*/ /dug gsum rnam rtog gnyen por gsungs/ /so skye tshul khrims la gnas dang*/ /dbang po'i sgo bsdams mi nyal brtson/ kha zas tshod rig shes bzhin gnas/ /byang sems tshogs lam yon tan lnga/ /'jog par byed dang rgyun du 'jog /klan 'jog nyer 'jog 'dul bar byed/

/zhi byed nyer zhi rgyud gcig byed/ /mnyam 'jog sems gnas thabs dgu yin/ /the tshom 'gyod gnyid le lo rgod/ /skyon lnga nyid yin gzhan yang ni/ /le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang*/ /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /gnas dang de la gnas pa dang*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang*/ /bying dang rgod dang rtog pa dang*/ /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang*/ /zhi tshe rnal du 'dug pa'o/ /de dag spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ /dkar po rnam mthong rigs kyi sa/ /brgyad pa mthong srab 'dod chags bral/ /byas pa bsrung ba'i sa de brgyad/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong*/ /dgra bcom zhugs 'bras brgyad po ste/ /nyan thos sa brgyad ces bya'o/ /dad tshul ngo khrel thos gtong shes/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun zhes su brjod/ /mthong ba thos pa rnyed pa bslab/ /rim gro rjes dran bla med drug /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /don mthun don spyod bsdu dngos bzhi/ /bden pa'i byin brlabs gtong nyer zhi/ /shes rab ces bya byin rlabs bzhi/ /gnod sems rnam 'tshe mi dga' dang*/ /'dod pa the tshom mtshan ma las/ /'byin byed tshad med nga rgyal bcom/ /mtshan med rnams te 'byung 'os drug /smra bo phun tshogs rnam pa bzhi/ /gzungs dang rab tu gsal byed dang*/ /dris lung ston dang 'dzin phun tshogs/ /gzungs kyang rnam pa bcur 'gyur te/ /don gzhung mngon shes 'od zer 'gyed/ /tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gzengs bstod dang*/ /spobs pa mi bzad pa dang ni/ /sna tshogs don la spobs pa'i gzungs/ /rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro ba/ /sbyangs dka' ba dang mngon du gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs dang stobs/

/smon lam ye shes phar phyin bcu/ grangs nges de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang*/ /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa'i yon tan dang*/ /de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phun tshogs rnam nges yin zhes bya/ /phyin drug mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /'dzam gling bdag dang 'khor bsgyur che/ /brgya byin 'thab bral dga' ldan bdag /rab 'phrul dbang bsgyur bdag po dang*/ /stong dang stong gnyis bdag tshangs pa/ /gnas gtsang bdag po dbang phyug che/ /sa bcur rnam par smin par gsungs/ /ting 'dzin brgya la snyoms 'jug dang*/ /sangs rgyas brgya mthong byin rlabs shes/ /'jig rten khams brgya g.yo snang byed/ /zhing brgyar 'gro zhing 'gro brgya smin/ /bskal brgyar sngon dang phyi mar 'jug /chos brgyar lus brgya 'khor brgya ston/ /stong dang 'bum dang bye ba brgya/ /bye stong bye ba stong brgya dang*/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang*/ /stong gsum 'bum dang de nyid kyang*/ /grangs med gsum brgya dang mtha' yas/ /mtshan nyid gang zag bslab pa dang*/ /phung po grub pa rtags dang ni/ /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa yi/ /gnas pa dang ni sa nyid do/ /sems can chos la dmigs pa dang*/ /dmigs med snying rje gsum du 'dod/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ / gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang na yang*/ /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /mu bzhi skye 'gog gcig du bral/ /yod med skye 'gog rten 'brel te/ /dbu ma'i rigs pa bzhi ru brjod/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa

dang*/ /rtse mor phyin dang mthar bgyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad/ /lam gyi chos kyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //me long ye shes mnyam nyid dang*/ /so sor rtog dang bya ba sgrub/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam lnga'o/ /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs byas dang*/ /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /gnas chos 'khor dus rnam pa nges/ /'og min theg chen sa bcu pa/ /rgyun mi 'chad dang mtshan dpes spras/ /ston pa rnam snang gangs chen mtsho/ /longs sku nges pa lnga ldan no/ /kha dog dbyibs tshad yul dang rgyu/ /'bras bu bdag po phyogs dang ni/ /zhabs 'bring longs spyod 'phrin las dang*/ /phan 'dogs 'jigs med rten dang lam/ /bzhon pa sgo dang bzhi bco brgyad/ /'og min gnas kyi spy-i sdom yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa gsum/ /sku'i sprul pa rnam pa gsum/ /rdzu 'phrul kun tu ston pa dang*/ /skye ba kun tu ston pa dang*/ /las kyi rnam smin kun tu ston/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni cho 'phrul dang*/ /kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /cho 'phrul gsum du rab tu brjod/ /zag med sde tshan nyer gcig ni/ /byang chub phyogs 'thun tshad med dang*/ /rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni/ /snyoms 'jug yi bdag nyid dang/ /zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni/ /rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*/ /nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /mngon shes so so yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*/ /dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*/ /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*/ /srung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam gsum dang*/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang*/ /bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*/ /skye la thugs rje chen po dang*/ /thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/

/bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*/ /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta/ /mi yi nyon mongs yongs spongs nyid/ /grogs sogs su de'i nyon mongs dag /rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med/ /sangs rgyas smon gnas mkhyen pa ni/ /lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang*/ /thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang*/ /'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed/ /rten dang dmigs pa thugs dang ni/ /ye shes rnam par dag pa bzhi/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs dang*/ /las dang rnam smin mkhyen stobs dang*/ khams sna tshogs dang mos sna tshogs/ /dbang mchog mchog min mkhyen stobs gsum/ /thams cad 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen stobs/ /bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin sogs/ /snyoms 'jug kun byang mkhyen stobs dang*/ /sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen stobs dang*/ /'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen stobs dang*/ /zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs de bcu/ /mngon par rdzogs par byang chub dang*/ /zag pa zad dang bar gcod chos/ /nges 'byung chos la mi 'jigs pa/ /rgyal ba'i mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa la/ /srung ba med pa rnam pa gsum/ /gus pas chos nyan mi nyan dang*/ /gnyis ka la yang thugs mnyam pa/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam gsum mo/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum bag chags spangs pa'o/ /rtogs pas bsdus dang spyod bsdus drug /ye shes bsdus gsum 'phrin las gsum/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad yin te 'dir/ /'khrul ca bsnyel g.yo tha dad btang snyoms med/ /'dun brtson dran ting shes grol nyams pa med/ /dus gsum chags thogs med pa'i ye shes gsum/ /sgo gsum 'phrin las ye shes sngon rjes 'jug /rgyu 'bras gzhan phan phun sum tshogs/ /phung nyon 'chi lha bdud bzhi bcom/ /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang*/ /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/

/drug po de la skal zhes bya/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam grol rnam grol ye shes mthong*/ /zag med phung po rnam lnga'o/ /sha lha shes chos sangs rgyas spyan/ /tshogs gnyis goms dang dus ring goms/ /rgyun goms bkur bstir byas te goms/ /rgyu ni phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ /ye shes spangs pa mthu dang gzugs/ /'bras bu phun tshogs rnam pa bzhi/ /ngan 'gro gsum dang 'khor las sgrol/ /bde 'gro dang ni theg gsum 'god/ /gzhan phan phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ /ma bstan mkhyen dang thams cad mkhyen/ /rnam kun mkhyen dang 'bad med mkhyen/ /ye shes phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ /nyon mongs kun spangs gtan du spangs/ /bag chags bcas spangs snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib spangs spangs pa rnam bzhi'o/ /sprul brgyur dang ni gtong 'dod dang*/ /chung ngur che 'jug ya mtshan chos/ /nar ma sna tshogs mnga' 'byor bzhis/ /nus mthu phun tshogs rnam bzhi 'o/ /mtshan bzang ba dang dpe byad bzang*/ /stobs dang sku gdung rdo rje ltar/ /sra ba'i yon tan mchog mnga' ba/ /gzugs sku phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ khams dang rang bzhin bsam pa dang*/ /bag la nyal kun mkhyen pa bzhi/ /brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang*/ /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /de ltar 'phrin las dpe dgu'o/ /thub dbang dus gcig kho nar de'i rgyu mthun/ /gzugs ni gcig la rang gi skye gnas skabs/ /sngar 'gags gsal dang ma 'chol 'byung tshul ni/ /ma lus kyi bkra mtha' dag ston par mdzad/ /dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yi/ rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ /rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phrar mi 'gyur/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' khyod kyi srid mtha'i bar/ /skad cig de re re la spyod sna tshogs/ /ji snyed ston pa de snyed 'dzam bu gling*/
/ma lus rdul gang de snyed la grangs med/ /gsungs dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang*/ /

'a 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /dpe byad brgyad cu thugs rje che/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs dbye ba/ /re zhig bdag gis 'dir ma bkod/ /rten dang brten pa don dam dang*/ /kun rdzob bral dang rnam smin dang*/ /chos dang gzugs sku rang don dang*/ /gzhan don sku zhes bya ba yin/ /'bras bu'i chos kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //da ni lnga pa sna tshogs pa'i sde bshad par bya'o/ /chen po bdun ni/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /'byor pa bcu ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*/ /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang der rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o/ /rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga/ /mi khoms pa brgyad ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/ /kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni/ /log lta can dang sangs rgyas stongs/ /lkugs pa 'di dag mi khoms brgyad/ /sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa dang ltas bco brgyad ni/ shar mtho nub ni dma' ba dang*/ /de bzhin phyogs bzhi dbus mtha' drug /'byung ngo 'ur dang rab tu 'ur/ /kun tu rab tu 'ur de bzhin/ /sprin sogs chem dang ri sogs 'gul/ /sa gzhi ldeg dang nags tshal g.yos/ /chu sogs 'khrugs sogs gsum bco brgyad/ /sdug bsngal brgyad ni/ skye rga na 'chi 'dod mi rnyed/ /sdug bral mi sdug phrad pa dang*/ /mdor na nyer len phung sdug bsngal/ /skye gnas bzhi ni/ mngal sgong drod gsher rdzus skyes so/ /zas bzhi ni/ reg dang sems pa rnam shes dang*/ khams kyi zas zhes bya ba'o/ /sems can gyi gnas dgu ni/ lus dang 'du shes tha dad dang*/

/lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig /mdog dang lus dang 'du shes gcig /gzugs med bzhi dang 'du shes med/ /sems can gyi ni gnas dgu yin/ /lta ba nyon mongs sems can tshe/ /bskal pa'i snyigs ma lnga zhes brjod/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed snyan mi snyan/ /bstod smad bde sdug chos brgyad do/ /mu stegs kyi ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad la/ rtog ge pa drug ni/ 'od srung rdzogs byed/ kun tu rgyu gnag lhas gyi bu/ smra 'dod kyi bu'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can/ mi pham skra'i lwa ba can/ kā ta'i bu nog can/ gcer bu ba gnyer gyi bu'o/ /snyoms 'jug pa drug ni/ sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur/ rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod/ drang srong nyon mongs med/ bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal/ kun tu rgyu rab bzang*/ ltengs rgyas 'od srung ral pa can no/ /rjes sgrog pa drug ni/ bram ze rgyus rgyal/ gnag ldeg bzang ldan/ tshangs pa'i tshe/ pad+ma'i snying po/ dmar po'o/ /mang bkur 'od mdzes dge ba dang*/ /dge mchog gso sbyong nga las nu/ /sngon gyi rgyal po de drug go gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo can/ /gling bzhi gsum dang gnyis dang gcig /phas bsu rang 'gro g.yul bsham dang*/ /mtshon brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med/ /legs sbyar rang bzhin zur chag skad/ /sha za'i skad de skad rigs bzhi/ /byed pa'i skyes bu rnams ni/ bdag sems can srog skye ba gso ba skyes bu gang zag shed las skyes shed bu byed pa po tshor ba po shes pa po mthong ba po slong ba po'o/ /nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad ni/ shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba dang*/ /rtag par smra ba'i sde tshan ni/ /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ / gzhi kun pa dang 'od srung dang*/ /sa ston sde dang chos srung dang*/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang*/ /rnam par phye ste smra ba ni/ /thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med ri/

/gcung chen gnas brtan sde ba'o/ /sa sgrog ri dang srung ba pa/ gnas ma bu'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyi bkur pa rnam pa gsum/ /lha mi'i 'khor lo bzhi ni gang*/ /mthun pa'i yul na gang gnas pa/ /skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/ /bdag gi yang dag smon lam btab/ /sngon gyi bsod nams bsags pa'o/ /mgo gcig dang ni rnam phye dang*/ /dri dang bzhag pa lung bstan bzhi/ /dbang po gzugs can lnga po dang*/ /pho mo srog yid ces pa bzhi/ /bde dang yid bde sdug btang snyoms/ /yid mi bde ste tshor dbang lnga/ /dad sogs lnga dang kun shes dang*/ /kun shes byed dang kun shes ldan/ /de ltar dbang po nyer gnyis so/ /chos gsum ni/ bshad dang sgrub pa 'bras bu'i chos/ /dgongs ldems dgongs brgyad ni/ mnyam pa nyid dang don gzhan dang*/ /de bzhin du ni dus gzhan dang*/ /gang zag gi ni bsam pa la/ /dgongs pa rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ /gzhug pa ldem por dgongs pa dang*/ /mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa dang*/ /gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa dang*/ /bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa'o/ /brton pa bzhi ni/ tshig la mi brton don la brton/ gang zag la mi brton chos la brton/ rnam shes la mi brton ye shes la brton/ drang don la mi brton nges don la brton/ 'dus ma byas gsum de bzhin nyid/ /'dus ma byas pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rig gnas bco brgyad la/ rol mo 'khrig thabs 'tsho tshes grangs/ /sgra dang gso spyad chos lugs bzo/ /'phongs dpyad gtan tshigs rnal 'byor thos/ /dran pa skad cig mig 'phrul dang*/ /sngon byung ba dang sngon rabs so/ /gzhan yang brtags pa bco brgyad dang*/ /rgyu rtsal drug cu la sogs yod/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la/ nang rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gso ba rigs pa/ bzo rig pa'o/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /bzo la lus bzo ngag bzo yid bzo gsum/ /gso bya gso byed ji ltar gso ba'i tshul/ /brda sprod rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum/

/mngon gyur lkog gyur shin tu lkog gyur gsum/ /nang rig sde snod gsum du grags shing grub/ /gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang*/ /chos don smos phyir mdo sde yin/ /mngon 'du'i phyir dang yang yang dang*/ /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /ltung dang 'byung dang ldang ba dang*/ /nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang*/ /bcas pa dang ni rab dbye dang*/ /rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ /rgyu gsum bzhi dang brgyad kyis ni/ /sde snod gsum du rnam par bzhag /bslab pa gsum ni/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang*/ /shes rab ces bya bslab pa gsum/ /chos lnga ni/ ming dang mtshan ma rnam rtog dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dang mi rtog shes/ /chos sdom phyag rgya bzhi ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag /zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med/ mya ngan las 'das pa rab tu zhi ba'o/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi rmi ltas bco brgyad ni/ glang chen khron pa phye dang be'u dang*/ /kun dga' ra ba 'thab dang ras yug dang*/ /me tog rdze'u gsum tsan dan spyi cer dang*/ /rta khyi ba dang phyi dro rgas pa dang*/ seng ge spre'u rgyal mi gtsang skud pa'o/ /yang bcu ni/ glang ngan khron pa phyi dang tsan dan dang*/ mu tig be'u spre'u rgyal mi gtsang skud/ chom rkun ras yug bgo bsha' byed pa'o/ /dgod pa bzhi ni/ theg pa bden pa rigs dang chos la dgod/ rigs pa bzhi ni/ ltos pa dang ni bya ba byed/ /'thad pa sgrub dang chos nyid rigs/ /mngon shes myur bul dka' sla la/ /lam bzhir rnam par dbye bar bya/ /blo rtul mngon shes bul ba ste/ /gcig shos kyi ni mngon shes myur/ /slong dang ming dang khas 'che dang*/ /gsol bzhi'i las dang nyon mongs bral/ /dge slong lnga zhes brjod pa yin/ /'dod chags gnod sems rmugs gnyid 'gyod/ /rnam g.yeng the tshom zhes bya bdun/ /gnyis bzhi gcig rnams bslab gsum la/ /rim pa bzhin du sgrib pa yin/

/phyin ci log gi lta tshul min/ /yid byed bzhi ni/ mi gtsang la sogs bzhi po la/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag par 'dzin/ /rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad ni/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun 'byin dang*/ /ltar snang bcas pa gzhan go byed/ /bslu ba'i bdud bzhi ni/ thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*/ /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /bslu byed bdud ni rnam pa bzhi/ /gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ /tshor ba chu'i chu bur 'dra/ /'du shes smig sgyu lta bu ste/ /'du byed chu shing 'dra bar gsungs/ /rnam par shes pa sgyu ma 'dra/ /bsam gtan sa dgu ni/ bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i nyer sdogs tsam po dang*/ nyer sdogs mi lcogs med pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi dang*/ /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa'i nyer sdogs dang dngos gzhi'o/ / bstan bcos dgu ni/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spongs/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /mdo sogs 'chad pa'i man ngag ni/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*/ /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par byas/ /grub mtha' smra ba bzhi ni/ bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma pa/ /bye brag smra ba ni/ nyi 'og kha che tho gar ba gsum mo/ /dbu ma pa ni/ rnal 'byor spyod dang mdo sde spyod/ /'jig rten grags sde spyod pa dang*/ /phyi mo'i dbu ma pa ste bzhi/ /mu stegs kyi grub mtha' las byung ba khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu ni/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa dang*/ /mi yi seṅge mi'u thung dang*/ /dga' byed rā ma dā ma dang/ /sangs rgyas kalki ta ste bcu/ /bye brag pa'i tshig don drug ni/ rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /rig byed bzhi ni/ nges brjod mchod sbyin snyan tshig

dang*/ /srid bsrung zhes bya rig byed bzhi/ /bram ze'i las drug ni/ klog dang klog 'jug mchod sbyin dang*/ /mchod sbyin byed 'jug sbyin dang len/ /shes bya nyer lnga ni/ bdag dang gtso bo blo nga rgyal/ /gzugs sogs de tsam lnga dang ni/ /sa chu me rlung mkha' dang mig /rna sna lce lpags rkang lag 'phongs/ / 'doms dang ngag yid nyi shu lnga/ /mgu ba dgu ni/ chu dang chu rgyun chu po char/ / legs brgal gzhan min mig bzang dang*/ /'od can lus mchog mgu ba dgu/ grub pa brgyad ni/ sgrol po legs sgrol sgrol mthar phyin/ /mgu gyur nyams dga' rab dga' dga'/ /mchog dga' zhes pa grub pa brgyad/ /nus pa nyer brgyad ni/ dbang po bcu gcig skyon can nus/ /mgu dang grub pa 'gal zla ni/ /mi dga' ma grub sogs bcu bdun/ /phyin ci log lnga ni/ mun rmongs rmongs chen shin tu mun/ /smag gyur phyin ci log lnga yin/ /mi mthong pa'i rgyu brgyad ni/ ha cang ring phyir nyer phyir dang*/ /dbang po nyams phyir yid med phyir/ /cha phra phyir dang sgrib phyir dang*/ /zil gnon phyir dang 'dres phyir ro/ /lta ba ngan pa drug cu rtsa gcig ni/ rtag par smra ba rnam bzhi dang*/ kha cig rtag par smra ba bzhi/ /mtha' yod sogs bzhi mi spong bzhi/ /rgyu med gnyis ni sngon mthar rtog /'du shes yod smra bcu drug dang*/ /med smra brgyad dang de bzhin du/ /yod min med min smra ba brgyad/ /chad smra bdun dang tshe 'di la/ /mya ngan 'da' par smra ba brgyad/ /phyi ma'i mthar rtog lta ba'o/ gcer bu pa'i don dgu la/ srog dang gang zag sdom pa dang*/ /nges par rgas dang 'ching pa dang*/ /las dang sdig dang bsod nams dang*/ /thar ba zhes bya don dgu po/ /'byung lnga dus phyogs bdag yid ni/ /rdzas dgur bye brag pa rnams 'dod/ /rig pa can pa'i tshig don bcu drug ni/ tshad ma gzhal bya the tshom dgos pa dpe/ /grub mtha' cha shas rtog ge gtan la dbab/

/brjod pa rtsod pa sun 'byin rgyu ltar snang*/ /tshig don ltag chod tshar gcod gnas rnams so/ /dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad ni/ phra yang mchod 'os bdag por gyur/ /dbang gyur gar phyin 'dod dgur bsgyur/ / dga' mgur gnas pa dbang phyug brgyad/ /lha bzhi ni/ tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug ste/ /bzhi pa nai ra dz+nyā na'o/ /da ni gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos ni/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs dag gi /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can te chos/ /dge 'dun ni/ ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /byang sems kyi sprul pa bcu ni/ sems can lus zhing mchod dbyangs spyod/ /smon smin gdul ba byang chub chos/ /byin rlabs zhes bya sprul pa bcu/ /byang sems rgyu mthun bcu ni/ byang sems dge bshes phar phyin chos dang smin nam spyod/ <'dir nor chad yod par 'dra bas dpyad dgos so/ /yig gtag pa'i mchan > sems pa mchod pa de bzhin gshegs/ /byang sems ngo mtshar 'du shes bcu ni/ dge dang sa bon snod 'du shes/ /chos kun la ni 'byung pa dang*/ /chos la sangs rgyas chos 'du shes/ /rgyal la pha dang gnyis med du/ /'du shes dang ni deganas gsum/ /smon nam sbyong pa tshig kun la/ /smon med la sogs rnam pa gsum/ /yongs smin bcu ni/ sbyin gzugs chos ston skal mnyam dang*/ /gnas med spyod pa rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /sangs rgyas ched brjod zhing rnams kyis/ /sems can khams yongs smin par byed/

/byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi 'jug pa bcu ni/ smon lam spyod pa yang dag sgrub/ /mos pa tha dad zhing gi rgyan/ /rnam 'phrul skye ba bstan la 'jug/ dbang bsgyur bcu ni/ lha mi gzugs stobs 'khor 'dod rgyal srid dang*/ /dbang phyug yon tan shes rab dbang bsgyur bcu/ /sangs rgyas chos las sems can dang*/ /spyod pa smon lam spyod yul dus/ /dge ba ye shes byin rlabs bcu/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la tshad med pa bcu ni/ mkha' dbyings chos dbyings sems can ltar/ /las ltar mos ltar nyon mongs ltar/ /sgra dbyangs thams cad pa lta bu/ /ye shes dus gsum tshad med ltar/ /sangs rgyas yul ltar tshad med bcu/ /mnyam nyid bcu ni/ sems can chos dang sangs rgyas zhing*/ /lhag bsam dge rtsa byang sems dpa'/ /smon lam phar phyin spyod sangs rgyas/ / mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba yin/ /byang sems kyi dga' ba bcu ni/ dran dang shes rab rtogs dang blo/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gzungs spobs pa/ /byang chub chos 'khor bskor ba yi/ /dga' ba bcu zhes brjod pa yin/ /mdo sde blta bar gyis shig dang*/ /'di sogs mtha' mu tshad med gsungs/ /sangs rgyas bcu dang sems can bcu/ /byang chub snying rje bcu drug dang*/ /'phrin las so gnyis la sogs pa/ /mangs kyi dogs pas re zhig bzhag /rgyan bzhi ni/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gzungs kyi brgyan/ /snang ba brgyad ni/ dran pa blo gros rtogs chos shes pa dang*/ /bden pa mngon shes sgrub pa'i snang ba brgyad/ /re re'i dbye ba dpag tu med pa dag /gzungs dbang gis zhus mdo sde nyid du ltos/ /rgyan bzhi snang brgyad snying rje bcu drug dang*/ /'phrin las so gnyis yongs sbyong drug cu yin/ /gzhan yang phal po che sa bcu pa dang*/ chos yang dag par sdud pa sogs cis kyang ltos shig dang blo gros mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i gnas bdun ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang*/

/yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bstan na/ /rdo rje'i yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go / da ni gsang sngags las byung ba ci rigs pa la/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang*/ /stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang*/ /sbyin bsreg mchod pa las sbyor dang*/ /slar sdud pa yi rnam pa ni/ /phyi'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /phyir zlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang*/ /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang*/ kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga dang*/ /gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ /drag shul sgrub pa'i cho ga dang*/ /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /rgyud sde gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi/ /lnga dang drug tu 'dod pa yin/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /bya rgyud drug ni/ de bzhin gshegs dang pad+ma dang*/ /rdo rje nor bu lnga brtsen dang*/ /'jig rten phal ba'i rigs te drug /spyod rgyud sku gsung thugs rigs gsum/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs de bzhin gshegs/ /khro bo 'gro 'dul don grub ste/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la rigs lnga'o/ /gnyis med bla na med pa la/ /thabs shes pha ma rnal 'byor dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnam pa bzhi/ /rigs lnga'am 'dod chags zhe sdang dang*/ /gti mug gi ni rgyud gsum po/ /thabs rgyud kyi ni dbye ba yin/ /rdor sems rnam snang he ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma gar dbang phyug /rta mchog ces bya ma rgyud drug /rnal 'byor bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa dang*/ /sgrub chen bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ / dang po sbyaur dang dkyil rgyal mchog /las rgyal mchog ste rang bzhin gsum/ / spyan drangs bzhugs dang gshegs su gsol/ /las gsum du ni brjod pa yin/ /rdzas dang lus dang longs spyod ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gsum du brjod/

/ dam tshig bzlas pa sbyin pa dang*/ /'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang*/ /dbang bskur pa dang las byed pa/ /slob dpon drug tu brjod pa yin/ /sa 'og steng 'gro ral gri dang*/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs nyid dang ni/ /ril bu mig sman gter dang ni/ /rkang mgyogs dang ni bcud kyi len/ /dngos grub dgu ru bshad pa yin/ /bzhi pa bor ba grub chen brgyad/ /gzhan du gnod sbyin mo yang bgrangs/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku yan lag bdun ni/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ro myang brgyad ni/ rtag pa dang ni mi gdung dang*/ /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang*/ /bde ba dang ni dri med dang*/ /dga' ba dang ni yid dang ba/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ ci 'dod byed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /'dus pa'i rim lnga ni/ sngags dang sems dang lus dang ni/ /rnam dag dang ni zung 'jug ste/ /rim pa lnga yi bsdus pa'i don/ /lus dben ngag dben sems dben dang*/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug go /sgom pa'i thig le bzhi ni/ snying kha nor bu sprul pa dang*/ /mi shigs thig le rnam bzhi'o/ /ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim gsum ni/ rang byin brlabs dang dkyil 'khor dang*/ /bsam mi khyab ces bya ba rnam gsum yin/ /sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /bde dgyes kyi rim pa bzhi ni/ rgyud sngags ye shes gsang rim bzhi/ /bde mchog rim lnga ni/ bdag byin brlabs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ /nor bu 'gengs dang 'bar 'dzeg bsam mi khyab/ /sgyu drwa nyi shu rnam lnga dang*/ /skad cig mngon rdzogs byang chub bzhi/ /e waṃ ma ya yi ge bzhi'o/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje dmangs bzhi/

/blta rgod lag bcings gnyis sprod bzhi/ / sad rmi gnyid stug bzhi pa ni/ /gnas skabs bzhi zhes bya ba yin/ /'dus ma byas bcas rnam thar bzhi/ /skad cig ma bzhi ni/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ rnam par nyed pa dang*/ mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ / dga' ba bzhi ni/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog tu dga' ba dang*/ khyad par gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /gdan bzhi ni/ bdag gzhan sbyor dang gsang ba'o/ /de nyid bzhi ni/ bdag sngags lha dang ye shes ni/ /de kho na nyid bzhi ru 'dod/ /rgyud bshad rgyan ni rnam pa bdun/ /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug yin/ /dbyug gu drug cu bzhi dang ni/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya dag las/ /mtha' yas rigs rnams 'phel ba yin/ /zhes pa slob ma la phan pa zhes bya ba rnam grangs kyi mdo ste/ las dang po pa kun dang*/ khyad par sde snod rgya chen po dag nyan par mi nus par sngags la 'jug pa dag la phan pa'i phyir dang*/ blo gsal mos ldan kun dga' chos dbyings kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ tā ra nā tha kun dga' snying pos rang lo nyer gsum gyi rtser son pa la/ dpal nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar pa'o/ /bkra shis/ /
